verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms https://docs.honeycomb.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown versions of doc pages. Many docs are served as agent-friendly .md files, including an `_llms/send-data.md` bundle. Honeycomb also ships an agent-skills plugin that gives AI assistants observability and Honeycomb-specific knowledge. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming the llms.txt/markdown docs, and first-party documentation describing how to point agents at llms.txt.
